purpose: Teach: 暴言/往来/斉唱/流星/昇る/追っかけ/エコー/ライティング

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者さんへの、本気で、絶対、暴言、絶対、医療現場、絶対、決して、絶対、許してはなりません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, abusive language toward patients has absolutely no place in a medical setting. Not ever.
lines.style: Steady, direct opening. Clinical tone without coldness. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. No rush. The voice of someone who has seen harm and will not accept it again.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 救急外来の、本気で、絶対、往来、絶対、激しい時、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、大変ですよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The emergency department gets intense quickly, doesn't it? The whole team really has their hands full.
lines.style: Thoughtful, sincere. Speaks from observation, not lecture. Pace gives space for agreement. Slight warmth acknowledging the weight of the work. He's listening as much as speaking.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。病院記念日の、本気で、絶対、斉唱、絶対、職員、絶対、皆で、絶対、行いました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We all sang together on the hospital anniversary. Everyone participated.
lines.style: Quieter now, almost reflective. A small smile in the voice — genuine warmth at the memory. Deliberate pace. She's sharing something real, not performing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昨夜の、本気で、絶対、流星、絶対、群、絶対、患者さん、絶対、窓から、絶対、楽しまれたそうですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard the patients really enjoyed watching the meteor shower from their windows last night.
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, slightly wondering tone. Speaks with care about the small moments that matter to patients. Pace is unrushed, intimate. He's genuinely asking, not filling space.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの体温、本気で、絶対、昇る、絶対、際の、絶対、対応、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When a patient's fever rises, we have strict protocols we follow every single time.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, professional reassurance. Calm, measured delivery. No flourish — just the facts presented with precision. The confidence of someone who has refined these procedures over years.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 有名な医師の、本気で、絶対、追っかけ、絶対、と言いますか、絶対、ファン、絶対、いらっしゃるんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Some of the well-known doctors here do have their admirers, don't they?
lines.style: Careful, slightly uncertain opening — testing the question. Gentle curiosity without presumption. Light, conversational pace. He's asking genuine permission to wonder about this.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。心臓の、本気で、絶対、エコー、絶対、検査、絶対、当院、絶対、最新機器、絶対、導入しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've invested in the latest ultrasound equipment for cardiac imaging. And we have ongoing training on medical writing for our staff.
lines.style: Clear, informative tone without being clinical. Each item presented with quiet pride in the institution's standards. Steady pace. She's answering fully but without excess words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医学論文の、本気で、絶対、ライティング、絶対、技法、絶対、貴院でも、絶対、研修されているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I appreciate how much you care about doing this work well.
lines.style: Warm, genuine close. Quiet voice, as if this is a small gift being offered. Pace slows slightly at the end. He means it, and he knows she'll hear it.
